name: alfred-mods
description: A Claude Code mod: context, usage, cost, tool failures, agents, cache and plan progress in one calm band and an /inspect pane. Works on Claude Code alone; with Alfred Code installed it also shows the stack's mode, runway and handoff.

leave_out_skipped_hooks.title: Leave out hooks a managed plugin skips
leave_out_skipped_hooks.description: Only where Claude Code notes 'alfred-mods: its ... hook was skipped': the mod leaves out those six hooks, which never run there, so the notices stop. Off elsewhere.
